title: F1597 Qualification and Physical Verification of Candidate h=2.5 um Donor Model
finding: Technical and physical qualification of candidate donor candidate_donor_h0025.inp (SHA-256 4C82B66BDA1D925C...) confirms: (1) Exact BVP conformance: 40x40 mesh (1600 quads, h=2.5 um), 1698 nodes, 17 duplicated slit nodes along y=0.05 mm (x<=0.04 mm), det(J)>0 everywhere, and RP displacement ramp to u_top=0.005 mm (matched donor state at u_top=0.00254 mm, frame 650). (2) The authoritative physical length scale is resolved as l0 = 0.0075 mm (7.5 um), yielding l0/h = 3.0 elements across the damage band (resolving the prior coarse smearing where h=5.0 um gave l0/h=1.5). (3) Frozen production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (SHA-256 CE8D5EDCD2911DCB...) is bitwise verified. (4) HPC submission is deferred under verified dual offline blockers: local guard ADAPTIVE_REMESHING_OFFLINE_MODE=1 and remote DNS unreachability (mlogin01.hrz.tu-freiberg.de). No-submission exit criteria are strictly met.

length_scale_resolution.resolution_finding: The physical regularization length scale is unambiguously l0 = 0.0075 mm (7.5 um). The 5.0 um value mentioned in prior diagnostics refers strictly to the element discretization size h_coarse = 5.0 um of Package 50, which provided only 1.5 elements across l0. The candidate donor at h = 2.5 um provides l0/h = 3.0 elements, resolving the damage band.

Standing research governance strictly prohibits human permission prompts, credential bypasses, or dummy job manufacturing. Submission must remain deferred.
